### 2026-10-09 – I started the schematic for my starbie. I am going to call it sunbie and make it shaped like the sun. Instead of using the MPU-6050 breakout board, I opted to use the bare chip. I will probably also a

**2h**

I started the schematic for my starbie. I am going to call it sunbie and make it shaped like the sun. Instead of using the MPU-6050 breakout board, I opted to use the bare chip. I will probably also add some type of light sensor so it could maybe sleep at night and maybe replace the dht11 with a bme280 so i can get altitued and show cool animations when going up or down things
